Overview

Akron is a city in OH with a population of 190,469. Rubber City with cheap housing, minor league baseball, and a revitalizing downtown. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
